postconditions.description: The number of cycles k is between 1 and n^2, inclusive.

postconditions.expression: Each edge is in exactly 2 cycles
postconditions.description: Each edge in the graph is included in exactly two cycles.

postconditions.expression: Each cycle has a length of 3 or 4
postconditions.description: Each cycle in the solution consists of either 3 or 4 vertices.

postconditions.expression: 1 <= v_i <= n for all v_i in all cycles
postconditions.description: All vertices in each cycle are within the range from 1 to n.
Output is -1 if there is no solution.
